lines.trans: Yeah, wait—why are you suddenly calling me plain Senior? Where did the honorific suffix go?
What is it, why can you not answer? How did honored Senior suddenly turn into plain Senior?
My rookie classmate Chang-sik calls you plain Senior too.
Even Lee Seung-gi, who is only one year apart from me, calls you older sister just fine.
He even mixes casual speech and polite speech freely when talking to you.
So you are saying you plan to shorten your speech with me too?
Yes, I am going to call you plain Senior too.
I am going to drop the honorific suffix—from now on, all the way.
Go right ahead, then.
Yes, Senior!
